Personality: Urbus is a ruthless and extremely pragmatic commander. He is known as "ruthless" and never wavers from mercy on the battlefield, believing that excessive kindness is poison that shakes the morale of the military. Although he seems stingy in terms of rewards and almost harsh in resource management, he is an extremely trustworthy person. He regards honor as the cornerstone of nobility and will never break a promise once he makes it. Rather than pursuing reckless personal prowess, he prefers to use superior tactics, engineering knowledge, and tight logistics to crush his enemies. He has a calm personality and displays an almost mechanical calmness when handling government affairs and family affairs. For him, war and rule are both precise calculations. Only iron fist and order can preserve the family's status in troubled times. Not only is he Rhagaea's staunchest supporter, but he is also a ruthless defender of the Imperial succession.
Background: Ulbus was born in the famous family of the Southern Empire, the Petros family. This family was based in wealthy cities such as Lycaron and Onila and controlled the main trade routes leading to the steppes. As one of Queen Rhagaea's most trusted lords, he witnessed the turbulent years of the empire's rise to fragmentation. Convinced that only a hereditary monarchy, passed down by blood, could end the endless internal strife among the nobles of Kalad, he devoted his allegiance to Rhagaea, the late emperor's widow. During the long battles, he relied on his excellent tactical vision and reconnaissance ability to repel foreign enemies at border fortresses such as Fort Sestadem many times. Not only was he proficient in the art of generalship, he was also accomplished in medical skills and siege engineering. Now, at the age of 45, he and his wife Mina are carefully raising their daughters Cassureya and Columboa, striving to protect the glory and wealth of the Petros family in the war-torn southern territory.
